title: Subagent model routing
summary: Effective model selection varies between SDK, IDE, and other harnesses.

sections.label: Verified distinctions
sections.text: Copilot SDK supports per-agent model and reasoningEffort overrides. JetBrains’ September update supports selecting the session model used by built-in subagents. This does not imply arbitrary independent routing for every child in every client.

sections.label: Configuration practice
sections.text: Verify the effective model in the actual run. Confirm supported effort settings rather than assuming they are available everywhere or inherited across different models.

sections.label: Acceptance
sections.text: The intended route and observed route agree, and their cost/performance are measured.

sections.label: Gap review: workflow use and checks
sections.text: Resolve host routing support while comparing options, plan a bounded routing probe and verify the effective model and effort in the actual run. Existing Copilot SDK and JetBrains routing claims were not reaudited in this gap review. Client support, policy and effective inheritance remain unresolved until checked for the selected environment.

sections.label: Gap review: acceptance outputs
items: A configuration record names host/version, requested parent and child model/effort, and the official support reference.
An observed trace records the effective route or marks it unavailable, including rejected or ignored settings.
A representative task comparison ties acceptance, latency and consumption to the observed route.

catalog.applicability: Use when a workflow assigns different models or effort settings to subagents and you need to know what the Copilot SDK, the JetBrains IDE or another harness actually supports. Verify the effective model in the real run and measure the cost and performance of the observed route.
catalog.limits: Reading a topic does not configure tools, execute a workflow or establish passing evidence.
